description: State checkpointing, time travel, diffing, and undo operations. Supported actions: save (create named checkpoint), list (list checkpoints), diff (compare two snapshots), get_state (reconstruct graph state at historical timestamp), revert (rollback graph to historical timestamp), undo (revert last mutation on a node), get_history (chronological audit log for a node).

action.description: The snapshot management action to execute.

force.description: Force snapshot even if node count is high.

node_id.description: Node ID for undo or get_history.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for get_state or revert.

name: manage_snapshots
